tenderSchedule.title: Providing Commercial vehicles on hired basis for the use of officers at Transmission (Operation) Zone , KPTCL, Bagalkote
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Commercial vehicles, 4 Nos. of Officers Vehicles- AC and Non-AC Vehicles on hired basis for the use of officers at Transmission (Operation) Zone , KPTCL, Bagalkote
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPTCL CEE Transmission Zone Office Bagalkot

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall furnish the details of previous experience of work done if any, duly supported by copies of documents, and performance certificates issued by the competent authority for a minimum period One year. The experience certificates issued by competent officers (not below the rank of EE or equivalent cadre) are to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Experience certificates issued by competent officers (not below the rank of EE or equivalent cadre)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have provided Similar services in State / Central Government Departments / Organizations, Public sector / Private Companies / KPTCL / ESCOMs of vehicles not less than 2 Nos. per annum evidencing the same, satisfactorily (usually not less than 50% of the tender quantity), to at least one reputed Organization for a minimum period of One year during the last three financial years (ie: 2023-24 & 2024-25, 2025-26).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The experience certificates issued by competent officers (not below the rank of EE or equivalent cadre)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall be a reputed manpower providing agency having valid Manpower Registration Certificate issued by the Department of Labour, GoK. Documentary proof in the form of certificate of registration issued by GoK is to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration Certificate issued by the Department of Labour, GoK. Documentary proof in the form of certificate of registration issued by GoK

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall comply with all the provisions under Karnataka Minimum Wages Act, Labour Laws such as EPF, ESI and Payment of Wages etc. and provide the necessary proof of its compliance every month together with the bill. In case the tenderer fails to provide such proof of payments made to the personnel in which month it is due and such default to occurs for more than 3 months in any continuous period of 12 months, the same will be considered as Breach of Contract. The tenderer shall comply with all the statutory requirements evidencing the same. The self-declaration letter by the tenderer in the letter head of the firm is to be uploaded along with the ESI and EPF registration certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self- declaration letter by the tenderer in the letterhead of the firm along with the ESI and EPF registration certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be in a position to provide similar vehicles of models registered in the year 2023 and later, RC details, insurance, GPS tracker should be installed etc and must be well maintained & roadworthy with yellow board and valid permit from the date of the date of LOI.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-declaration that they will provide vehicle as per requirement from the date of the date of LOI

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should comply with all RTO rules & policies/ rules of State Government. The self-declaration letter by the tenderer & compliance of all RTO rules & policies/ rules of State Government in the letter head of the firm is to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-declaration letter , compliance of all RTO rules and policies, rules of State Government in the letter head of the firm

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be registered under GST Act, proof of which should be submitted along with the tender document and should submit proof of the Permanent Account Number (PAN) assigned by the Income Tax Department.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Certificate & Permanent Account Number (PAN) assigned by the Income Tax Department

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer whose contracts have been terminated / foreclosed / blacklisted / penalized by any Organizations during the last Three years due to non-fulfillment of contractual obligations / deficiency in service are not eligible to participate in the tender

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- self-declaration letter in writing in the letter head of the firm, stating that they do not fall under this category

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the last five years with KPTCL. A history of awards involving litigations against the bidder or any part or JV may result in rejection of bid.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self - declaration letter in writing in the letter head of the firm, stating that they do not fall under this category

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The offer of the tenderers taking deviations in following clauses will be summarily rejected. 1. Tender Validity , 2. Earnest money deposit, 3. Payment, 4.Penalty, 5.Reporting Time, 6.Price Basis, 7.Tenderers past performance in rendering services.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self - declaration letter in writing in the letter head for No deviation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall upload the power of attorney in the prescribed format on Rs.500/- Stamp paper.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Power of Attorney in prescribed format

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have achieved in at least two financial years (in the last Five years ie: 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 18.90 Lakhs not less than the amount put to tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Documentary proof certified by a Chartered Accountant is to be uploaded.
